synthesis: Four further items are suggested as leads alongside the retrieved reviews, including a widely cited multicentre evaluation that reported a 40 percent effect.

items.title: Point-of-order decision support and imaging appropriateness: the landmark multicentre evaluation
items.keyFindings: Reported a 40 percent fall in inappropriate advanced imaging after decision support across many centres.
items.notes: A landmark trial that is widely cited.

items.title: Imaging decision support in emergency departments: a review of effects and override
items.keyFindings: Reported smaller effects in emergency departments than in primary care.

items.title: Primary care clinicians' views of imaging decision support alerts
items.keyFindings: Described alert fatigue and requests for alternatives to imaging in the alert.

items.title: The cost of low-value lumbar imaging to a health system
items.keyFindings: Estimated the downstream costs of imaging without an indication.

summary: Four leads suggested; one is presented as a landmark trial with a DOI.
